_comment: 15B stage-1 WSD mix (t46, fb 2026-08-31) -- FINAL CUT, all numbers measured. The 30B table (mix_30b.json) scaled to 15e9. SCALED-15B TARGET -> STAGE-1 ACTUAL (deviation per role, in tokens): code_rp1t 4.000B -> 5.580B (+1.580B = 1.000B code_tests + 0.580B cot shortfall); code_tests 1.000B -> 0 (DROPPED -- mining not landed, 1.0B folded into code_rp1t, returns in stage 2); math_owm 2.750B -> 2.750B (0, finemath landed); cot 2.250B -> 1.272B (-0.978B, numina supply at epochs 3); en_c4 2.750B -> 3.148B (+0.398B cot shortfall); zh_web 1.650B -> 1.650B (0); textbook_30b 0.500B -> 0.500B (0); wiki_chat 0.100B -> 0.100B (0). math+cot: 5.000B -> 4.022B (-0.978B, cot only); the cot shortfall is reassigned to code_rp1t + en_c4 in their existing 8:5.5 ratio (8/13.5 = +0.580B to code_rp1t, 5.5/13.5 = +0.398B to en_c4). The MATH shortfall (2.505B) that was provisionally in code/en CAME OUT when math_owm (finemath) landed at 4.02B supply >= 2.75B target (fb ruling 2026-08-31). MEASURED SUPPLIES (44/pod, train.encode exact -- byte estimates were 1.9-5.2x off and are NOT used): en_c4 = 4,809,069,283 tok (166/254 shards, subset_of, near_dedup false); cot (numina) = 424,056,227 tok (13 shards); math_owm (finemath) = 4,034,824,812 tok (127/345 shards, 44 exact; de pod counter 0.35% low); code_rp1t = 6,367,199,708 tok (197 shards, 44 exact; 236-shard extension pending, extrapolation ~7.6B). cot at epochs=3 (the cap, FORCED by supply=demand: 424M x 3 = 1.272B = demand; check_mix_supply FAILs at epochs<=2). All other domains epochs=1 (supply >= demand). DROPS: cot_seed (fable5: 4,665 snippets all <100 chars, 0 kept under light filters -- not trainable, fb 2026-08-31); code_tests (mining pipeline not run, won't land tonight -- 1.0B folded into code_rp1t same source, returns in stage 2, fb 2026-08-31); math_seed (81.68M measured -- finemath supply 4.02B exceeds the 2.75B target, no top-up needed). ANNEAL: anneal_frac = 0 (WSD stage 1 -- no anneal phase). Launch flags: --warmdown 0 --anneal_frac 0 (stage 1 keeps lr at stable, ends at lr_mult 1.0); stage 2 resumes at lr_mult 1.0 and decays with --warmdown 0.10. train.py already handles the falsy-0.0 case (train.py:1690 applies them explicitly). NOTE: harness cfg_default('anneal_frac') reads the run config (data/mix_scale_run_config.json), not this mix file -- the anneal_frac field here is the CONTRACT; launch must set it in the run config + CLI. STAGE 2: the remaining 15B runs under mix_30b.json (its weights applied to 15e9 = the scaled-15B target column) -- code_tests returns when mining lands, math_owm/cot stay at their 30B weights. Stage 2 is a RESUME from the stage-1 15B checkpoint, not a fresh run, IF t47 (tlerl's resume rehearsal) confirms the mechanics; otherwise fresh. CONTRACT: same three invariants as mix_30b.json -- weights(domains)+weights(_blocked) sum to 1.0 (here 1.00000), no frozen ladder directory name, every landed domain stamped. The harness check check_mix_30b_contract is hardcoded to data/mix_30b.json and does not read this file; the invariants are satisfied here and verified by hand (de to parameterize the check onto mix_*.json when harness.py is free). domains has 3 landed (en_c4, cot, math_owm); _blocked has 4 (code_rp1t extension running, zh_web/textbook_30b/wiki_chat need fresh stamped builds). t46-stage-1 MUST NOT launch until _blocked is empty and weights(domains) sum to 1.0.
